entities.summary: Île Tintamarre, also known as Flat Island, is a small island with an area of approximately 0.8 square kilometres (0.3 mi2). It is located in the Caribbean Sea, about 3 kilometres (2 mi) from the island of Saint Martin, and is administered as part of the French overseas collectivity of Saint Martin. The island has no human occupants, but has been inhabited in the past.
